title: Hebron glassblowing
summary: Blow a squat jug with a narrow neck and a handle from thick blue and green glass full of tiny bubbles.
howToPlay: Match the shape in the frame.
Drag across each row to set its width.
Tap the bands to dip them in blue and green glass.
rules: The jug has a round belly, a narrow neck and a flared lip, with a handle of the same glass.
Shape counts for 70 of the 100 points and the colour of the bands for 30.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn blows a whole jug for you.
heritageNote: The glassmakers of Hebron have long blown coloured glass by hand, much of it from recycled glass. Thick walls, small bubbles and deep blue and green are the mark of their jugs, bowls and bottles.
